BETTE concept 1

from the Sun into food inside the plant in the correct order :

(.........) Light from the Sun hits plant's leaves.
(........) Plant parts use the glucose for their needs and growth.
(.........) The leaves transform light energy from the Sun into glucose (chemical energy).
